t: Advanced Laser Connectors work just like $(l:laserio:laser_connector)Laser Connectors$(/l), connecting to other (basic) connectors and nodes up to 8 blocks away. $(br2)They can only be connected to one other Advanced Connector, however, forming a pair.  The connection range from one advanced connector to its partner is infinite - including across dimensions!
高级激光连接器和$(l:laserio:laser_connector)激光连接器$(/l)功能一致，可以连接至最远 8 格内的基础连接器和节点。$(br2)但是，它们只能与一个高级连接器相连，形成连接器对。对内高级连接器的连接范围没有距离上限⸺甚至能跨越维度！
Two Advanced Connectors linked to each other
两个互相连接的高级连接器

If an Advanced Connector already has a partner, and you attempt to pair it with a new partner, the original connection will be broken to form the new connection.  $(br2)When looking at the block with the $(l:laserio:laser_wrench)Laser Wrench$(/l) in your hand, you'll see the coordindates of the partner block.
如果某个高级连接器已经处于对中，再试图连接至另一个高级连接器，则原来的连接会断开，同时形成新链接。$(br2)手持$(l:laserio:laser_wrench)激光扳手$(/l)看向高级连接器时，它会显示相连的高级连接器的坐标。
Showing the coordinates of the partner connector
显示相连的高级连接器的坐标
Advanced Laser Connectors do NOT chunk load for you. You are responsible for handling all chunk loading on your own! Nodes in unloaded chunks will not operate.
高级激光连接器$(l)不会$()加载区块，这一任务需要靠你去完成！未加载区块内的节点不会运作。
